DTF.name: DTF (direct-to-film)
DTF.hint: Versatile: photos, gradients and fine detail on cotton or polyester, light or dark.

SCREEN_PRINT.name: Screen printing
SCREEN_PRINT.hint: Best for runs: one screen per colour, vivid and very durable solids.

DTG.name: Direct-to-garment (DTG)
DTG.hint: Photos on cotton with no minimum; dark fabrics need a white underbase.

HEAT_TRANSFER_VINYL.name: Heat transfer vinyl
HEAT_TRANSFER_VINYL.hint: Jersey names and numbers: solid colours, strokes of at least 2 mm, no photos or gradients.

FLOCK.name: Flock
FLOCK.hint: Raised velvet finish: solid colours, strokes of at least 3 mm.

SUBLIMATION.name: Sublimation
SUBLIMATION.hint: All-over print with no hand feel: light polyester only.

EMBROIDERY.name: Embroidery
EMBROIDERY.hint: Premium for polos and caps: text at least 5 mm tall, few colours.
